1 // A stand-in for the memstated daemon: the three read routes that the Memory tab uses. It records
2 // every request, so that a test can check that the dashboard never writes to memstate.
3 
4 import http from 'node:http';
5 
6 export const MEMORIES = [
7   { id: 7, project_id: 'ideamine', keypath: 'task.summary.2026_09_21', content: 'Built the dashboard.', category: 'status', version: 2, created_at: 1790000000 },
8   { id: 3, project_id: 'ideamine', keypath: 'decisions.sync', content: 'The server holds the archive.', category: 'decision', version: 1, created_at: 1789990000 },
9 ];
10 
11 export async function startFakeMemstate() {
12   const requests = [];
13   const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
14     let body = '';
15     req.on('data', (d) => (body += d));
16     req.on('end', () => {
17       requests.push(`${req.method} ${req.url}`);
18       const json = (status, data) => res.writeHead(status, { 'content-type': 'application/json' }).end(JSON.stringify(data));
19       const input = body ? JSON.parse(body) : {};
20       if (req.method === 'GET' && req.url === '/api/v1/projects') {
21         return json(200, { projects: [{ id: 'ideamine', created_at: 1789900000, memory_count: 2, last_updated_at: 1790000000 }] });
22       }
23       if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/api/v1/keypaths') {
24         const list = MEMORIES.filter((m) => m.project_id === input.project_id).map((m) => ({ ...m, content: input.include_content ? m.content : '' }));
25         return json(200, { memories: list, total_count: list.length });
26       }
27       if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/api/v1/memories/history') {
28         const versions = [
29           { ...MEMORIES[0], version: 1, content: 'Started the dashboard.', created_at: 1789950000 },
30           MEMORIES[0],
31         ].filter((m) => m.keypath === input.keypath);
32         return json(200, { versions, total_versions: versions.length });
33       }
34       json(404, { error: 'not found' });
35     });
36   });
37   await new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
38   return { url: `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`, requests, close: () => new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve)) };
39 }
